capabilities: Enable Helix keybindings in the editor
Toggle Helix keybindings via a command
Customize cursor color with a CSS snippet
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the underlying CodeMirror 6 extension is described as being in a very early stage of development.
problem: Obsidian only offers Vim-style modal editing, so users who prefer Helix's keybindings have no way to edit with them.

relations.evidence: This plugin simply adds the extension to the editor

summary: Helix keybinding support for the Obsidian editor, added via jrvidal's Helix CodeMirror 6 extension.
